description:
The session area takes one recorded blanket disposition covering every record it holds, because the area is a uniform set of dated records where per-file inspection would be volume without added signal.

## Background

Each file's outcome is decided rather than open: 30 take the archived location an owning container's run produces. The blanket call is one decision — a session record follows its owning issue's archival outcome — and it holds for the whole area, because a terminal issue's document reference names every record in it. The enumeration below states that decision's scope rather than thirty separate judgements.

The disposition record is `disposition-session-records.md` inside this epic's canonical artifact directory, `dev/active/8e071e18-dev-artifact-layout`. The record's directory is the canonical artifact directory the command resolves for this epic in the active area rather than a path composed by hand, which makes this epic one of the convention's first consumers. Keeping the record in one document rather than inside each file leaves the historical documents' bytes untouched, for the same reason archival warns about in-content citations instead of rewriting them.
